description:
Elisha Lionet, the young owner of an old pawnshop.

In her first life, she was deceived by a distant relative who said he would take care of her sick grandfather, he had all of her grandfather’s property taken away, and did and her Grand father was met with a miserable death.

And in the second life; given to her as a miracle…

“Grandpa, the pawnshop, my life too—I’ll never let them take them again.” she swore to protect.

Returned from death, she resolved to protect her grandfather and the pawnshop she inherited from him.

“Does this pawnshop deal in people too?”

Customers who suddenly demand that she sell them,

“Who gave you permission to do business here?”

Customers who threaten her with thuggish intimidation,

“H-how did you know this is a holy relic?!”

Customers who were obviously trying to sell stolen goods…

Can Elisha overcome the interference of these rather strange customers(?)

and safely protect her grandfather and the pawnshop?
